decisions.reason: As a retained core door-handle family with visible design and launch investment, it remains closely tied to the firm's architectural hardware portfolio and management is likely to continue justifying that commitment.
This mitred handle family still fits the firm's design-led positioning and one-stop hardware offering, so prior investment and public portfolio commitment favor retention over withdrawal.
The multifunctional handle is especially aligned with the firm's barrier-free and system-solution direction, making management inclined to persist unless there is unmistakable evidence of failure.

Another handle family in the firm's main competence area benefits from sunk development, certification and sales-channel efforts, which under escalation of commitment support keeping it on the market.
The bronze finish is less central and easier to prune than a full product family, but as a complementary design option within the broader range it is still more likely to be kept than dropped.
